name: The Great Dalmuti
summary: Shedding ladder-climbing card game where players race to empty their hand to become Greater Dalmuti.
rules_text: Use 80 cards: 12x12 down to 1x1 and 2 Jesters. Jester alone is 13, with others acts as wild of that rank. For 4-8 players. After seating by random draw, Greater Peon deals whole deck. Taxation: Greater Peon gives 2 lowest to Greater Dalmuti for any 2 back; Lesser Peon gives 1 lowest to Lesser Dalmuti for any 1 back. If any player holds both Jesters they may call Revolution, reversing seat order (or cancelling tax). Greater Dalmuti leads any equal-rank set. Clockwise each player must play same size set of strictly lower rank or pass; wilds allowed. When all pass, last player to play leads new trick. First to empty is Greater Dalmuti next hand, last remaining is Greater Peon. Play continues.
